verdict.rationale: Lever publishes a public developer documentation site at hire.lever.co/developer/documentation. It covers REST-style endpoints (list, create and list-deleted applications; list audit events), OAuth authentication, and webhooks with setup, securing, payloads, configuration and responses. Partner guides and example apps support integration builders. Missing for 10: evidence of breadth across other core objects (candidates, postings, interviews, feedback), any independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works well for agent-driven use, and details on rate limits or SDKs.
